_comment: Real headlines captured from live pages on 2026-09-02/03, hand-labelled.
Sources: upworthy.com and buzzfeed.com front pages; test-data/pages/bbc.co.uk-*.html.
bait    = promises a payoff and withholds it; Click Unbait should fetch and reveal it.
plain   = states its own outcome; must not be flagged.
quiz    = interactive/quiz; no destination payoff to reveal, so out of scope either way.
unclear = genuinely arguable; excluded from the pass/fail thresholds rather than fudged.
Not every headline on a clickbait site is clickbait, and a straight news site runs soft
feature headlines - so the labels are per-headline, not per-source.
